command: set -eu; git fetch origin --prune; echo 'Remote branches before cleanup:'; git ls-remote --heads origin | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's#refs/heads/##' | sort; branches=$(git ls-remote --heads origin 'refs/heads/work/*' 'refs/heads/fix/*' | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's#refs/heads/##'); for branch in $branches; do echo "Deleting $branch"; git push origin --delete "$branch"; done; git fetch origin --prune; echo 'Remote branches after cleanup:'; git ls-remote --heads origin | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's#refs/heads/##' | sort
